description: This file contains a utility class HandlerUtil that provides methods for managing and retrieving handler components within the OpenMRS framework, utilizing annotations, caching, and context management.

classes.name: HandlerUtil
classes.description: A utility class for discovering, filtering, and caching handler components annotated with @Handler within the OpenMRS context. It also responds to application context refresh events to clear cache.

classes.name: HandlerUtil.Key
classes.description: A private static inner class used as a key for caching handler lists based on handler type and supported class.

methods.name: getHandlersForType
methods.description: Retrieves and caches a list of handlers of a specific type supporting a given class, ordered by the Handler annotation's order property.

methods.name: getPreferredHandler
methods.description: Returns the single most preferred handler (the one with the lowest order value) for a specific handler type and class, throwing an exception if multiple or none are found.

methods.name: clearCachedHandlers
methods.description: Clears the cache of handlers, used upon application context refresh.

methods.name: getOrderOfHandler
methods.description: Returns the order attribute value from the @Handler annotation on a given handler class.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles ContextRefreshedEvent to clear handler cache.
